world.title: Ukraine killed 11 in tourist camp: Russia
world.summary: Russian authorities reported that an overnight attack by Ukraine on a holiday camp in a Russian-held area of Zaporizhzhia resulted in the deaths of 11 individuals, including four children. The incident has heightened tensions between the two countries, with Russia accusing Ukraine of targeting civilians. No further details regarding the attack or its circumstances have been disclosed.

world.title: Iran says it sold $18 bn of oil during war, ceasefire
world.summary: Iran's oil ministry reported selling $18 billion worth of oil during the war and subsequent ceasefire with the United States. The breakdown includes $11.5 billion during the war and $6.5 billion during the ceasefire, which ended earlier this month. This amount represents over 60% of the projected oil revenues for the year, despite previous claims of export challenges.

world.title: Ukraine moves to aid US in Iran war after striking Tehran-Moscow supply link
world.summary: Ukraine is increasing its involvement in the Iran war by offering to share intelligence on Russian support to Tehran. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced plans for Ukrainian intelligence to inform partner nations about Russia's role in preparing Iranian strikes against U.S. military facilities. Additionally, Ukraine has targeted vessels linked to the military supply network between Iran and Moscow.

business.title: ‘Cities prioritise people, not cars’: Indian man in Germany explains why Europe’s quality of life feels different
business.summary: An Indian man residing in Germany highlighted differences in quality of life between Europe and India, emphasizing that factors like safer roads, wider pavements, and cleaner parks contribute significantly. He argued that Europe's quality of life transcends mere economic indicators such as salaries, technology, or healthcare, suggesting that urban design prioritizing people over cars enhances daily living experiences.

business.title: Q1 Results in Coming Week: From ITC to Adani Enterprises - Check full list of companies announcing June quarter results
business.summary: Major companies, including Hindustan Unilever (HUL), L&T, Adani Enterprises, ITC, Maruti Suzuki, and Bajaj Finance, are set to announce their Q1 FY27 results between July 27 and August 2. This upcoming earnings season is anticipated to keep investors attentive as they await insights into the financial performance of these significant players in various sectors.

business.title: India’s hotel boom is changing—and these 3 stocks are built for what’s next
business.summary: India's hotel industry is evolving, focusing on capital efficiency alongside occupancy and room rates. This shift has led to significant operating improvements in hotels, with occupancy levels exceeding 70%. Three hotel stocks are highlighted for their strong return on capital employed (ROCE) and return on equity (ROE), positioning them well for the industry's next phase of growth.

technology.title: Someone polled 4K Blu-ray player owners about the reliability of different models over time, and there's a clear winner
technology.summary: A poll of nearly 400 4K Blu-ray player owners revealed significant differences in reliability among various models. Panasonic emerged as the most reliable brand, while Sony received less favorable feedback. Participants shared their real-world experiences, highlighting a clear distinction between the best and worst performers in the market, providing valuable insights for potential buyers.

technology.title: Everything Rockstar Still Has Not Shown About GTA 6
technology.summary: Rockstar is approximately four months away from the launch of GTA 6, with pre-orders available for about a month. The game’s cover art has been revealed, along with around 60 screenshots. Pricing has been established in major markets, and Take-Two Interactive has linked its financial outlook to the game's performance, highlighting its significance to the company's future.

sports.title: Ishan Kishan reveals Team India's plan to protect Vaibhav Sooryavanshi: 'We just make sure...'
sports.summary: Ishan Kishan discussed Team India's strategy to support young batter Vaibhav Sooryavanshi following the second T20I against Zimbabwe. He emphasized the importance of shielding Sooryavanshi from distractions, noting that senior players are actively helping him stay focused. Kishan praised the teenager's understanding of his game and the conduct expected of him as part of the team.

sports.title: Bavarian Football Works
sports.summary: Bayern Munich participated in a preseason friendly against Wehen Wiesbaden, celebrating the club's 100th anniversary. The match ended in a 1-2 loss for Bayern, who fielded a predominantly young team. This game marked Bayern's first friendly of the 2026/27 season. Despite the defeat, the event highlighted Wiesbaden's milestone and provided valuable experience for the younger players.

sports.title: GAW vs DV Today Match Prediction and Betting Tips, Odds and Live Score
sports.summary: The Guyana Amazon Warriors (GAW) will face the Desert Vipers (DV) in the fourth match of the Global Super League 2026. Scheduled for July 26, 2026, at 04:30 IST, GAW seeks to secure their second consecutive win. The match is part of an intensifying competition, highlighting the teams' strategies and performance predictions ahead of the encounter.

health.title: Global overuse of antibiotics fuels rising ‘superbug’ threat
health.summary: A study reveals that nearly all countries are overusing 'watch' antibiotics, which significantly contribute to antibiotic resistance. These stronger drugs are intended for use only when simpler antibiotics are ineffective. The findings highlight the urgent need for better antibiotic stewardship globally to combat the rising threat of 'superbugs' and preserve the effectiveness of essential medications.

health.title: More health workers strike as Ebola cases near 3,000
health.summary: Health workers at an Ebola treatment center in eastern Congo initiated a strike on Saturday due to payment disputes, impacting patient care amid a significant outbreak. As of Friday, confirmed Ebola cases in Congo reached 2,973, with 1,309 fatalities reported. Authorities are concerned about the escalating situation as the strike disrupts efforts to manage the epidemic effectively.

health.title: The Coffee Debate: Superfood or Hidden Health Problem?
health.summary: Research spanning decades highlights the mixed health signals of coffee, emphasizing the importance of preparation and consumption methods for consumers. A 2026 Center for Health Research study involving 131,000 participants found associations between heavier caffeine intake and various health outcomes. These findings contribute to the ongoing debate about coffee being a superfood or a potential health concern.

science.title: What happens to astronauts' bodies on the ISS? A look at how space affects bone, blood and eyes
science.summary: Astronauts on the International Space Station (ISS) experience adaptations due to microgravity. While they appear to float, gravity is still present; the ISS and its occupants are in continuous freefall. This environment affects various bodily systems, including bone density, blood circulation, and vision. Research continues to understand these changes and their implications for long-term space travel and health.

science.title: Scientists thought insects could never survive the deep ocean because their air-filled bodies would implode, but lake fly larvae in Africa's Lake Malawi are proving them wrong
science.summary: Scientists have long thought that insects could not survive in deep ocean environments due to their air-filled bodies collapsing under pressure. However, research on lake fly larvae from Africa's Lake Malawi challenges this belief, demonstrating that these larvae can withstand extreme conditions. This discovery may reshape understanding of insect adaptability and survival in various aquatic ecosystems.

science.title: 5 amazing facts about Saturn's largest moon Titan that you probably didn't know
science.summary: Titan, Saturn's largest moon, is notable for its thick atmosphere, making it unique among over 200 known moons in the solar system. It features a golden hazy atmosphere similar to Earth's, and is considered one of the strongest candidates for supporting life. Titan's intriguing characteristics continue to captivate scientists and researchers exploring its potential for habitability.

entertainment.title: Shagufta Ali recalls hiding stage 3 breast cancer, says fear of losing work kept her silent: ‘My savings ran out too’
entertainment.summary: Shagufta Ali disclosed that she kept her stage 3 breast cancer diagnosis a secret due to fears it would jeopardize her career. She mentioned societal pressures at the time discouraged open discussion about such illnesses, leading her to remain silent. Ali also expressed concerns about financial stability, stating her savings had depleted during her health struggles.

entertainment.title: Sagittarius Horoscope Today: July 26, 2026
entertainment.summary: Sagittarius individuals are experiencing a conflict between nostalgia and the desire for progress. The horoscope advises making a decisive move, emphasizing the importance of letting go of the past to embrace new opportunities. Remaining in familiar patterns may hinder growth, and while the transition may be challenging, it is essential for personal development. Now is the time to act.

entertainment.summary: On July 26, 2026, Taurus individuals are advised to adopt a higher perspective while pausing to assimilate recent learnings. This reflection is essential for strategically implementing plans and visions. Staying curious is emphasized, even if starting from scratch.
